name: Acorn CLI
description: The acorn CLI integration: /api/acorn/auth + /api/acorn/sessions HTTP routes (the Go-binary protocol contract), session:start / session:end WS handlers, the acorn settings pane, acorn-specific prompt sections (Project Context, Plan Mode), the webapp self-register team-key gate, and the graph_update temp-tagging middleware. Depends on session-graph for the underlying session-node persistence + note_discovery tool + recall-skip heuristic + per-turn breadcrumb helpers. Uninstall to disable acorn entirely; uninstall session-graph first if it has no other dependents.
